context_for_next_testing_agent: Level-2 AI Chat Actions fully implemented and tested. Key selectors: [data-testid='actions-<idx>'] for action rows, [data-testid='action-btn-<idx>-<n>'] for action buttons, [data-testid='followups-<idx>'] for chip rows, [data-testid='followup-chip-<idx>-<n>'] for chips. Admin Panel Chip CTR tab accessible via user menu -> Admin Panel -> Chip CTR tab.

POST /api/chat/followups.details: Returns {chips:[3 strings], actions:[0-2 items]}. Ticker-specific replies get research+watchlist actions. Generic replies get empty actions.

POST /api/analytics/chip-event.details: Accepts shown/clicked/action-shown/action-clicked. Invalid actions return {ok:false, reason:'bad_action'}. Events persist to MongoDB chip_events collection.

GET /api/analytics/chip-events/stats.details: Returns window_days, shown, clicked, ctr, action_shown, action_clicked, action_ctr, top_clicked[], top_actions[]. Admin/owner role required.

Frontend L2 Action Buttons.details: Cyan-accented buttons with arrow (→) suffix render in 'Go' row above gray L1 chips in 'Next' row. Clicking routes to target hub and closes chat.

Admin Panel Chip CTR Tab.details: 5 KPI grid (Shown, Clicked, L1 CTR, L2 CTR amber, Signal High/Medium/Low) + Top Clicked Chips table + Top Clicked Deep-Link Actions table.

L1 Chip Click Behavior.details: Clicking followup chip sets input and fires 'clicked' telemetry. Auto-send behavior verified in code.
